title: Meta连跌11天：巨额投入何时回报？，市场参与者心里没底
speaker: Maribel Lopez

segments.en: No, can I ask you about Merah, and I'm a bit hesitant to directly tie the market reaction to what the company said, because the stock is also also done well, so it could be partly related of course. I think I was checking the statistic today, here we go, stock is down 11 straight days, long since it went public back in 2012.
segments.zh: 我能问问你关于Meta的事吗？我有点犹豫是否直接将市场反应与公司言论挂钩，因为股价也表现不错，所以可能部分相关。我今天查了一下数据，股价已连续下跌11天，这是自2012年上市以来最长的连跌。

segments.en: Did anything go wrong in your view with the meta story?
segments.zh: 在你看来，Meta的故事出了什么问题吗？

segments.en: So one of the things that investors are really struggling with right now with the meta story is they're investing a lot of capital, unlike hyperscalers, they're not really going to sell a lot of cloud computing services.
segments.zh: 投资者目前对Meta故事的一个困扰是，他们投入了大量资本，但与超大规模云厂商不同，他们并不会出售大量云计算服务。

segments.en: So all of that has to be monetized with some form of AI services or advertising services, and the big unknown, and this is a very large significant unknown, is when we will start to see the impact of the AI model providers, the new AI search providers, companies like Proplexity, companies like OpenAI, who have made stated opinions about how they want to be the next wave of commerce and helping with that next wave of advertising commerce, how is that going to impact meta?
segments.zh: 因此所有这些都必须通过某种形式的AI服务或广告服务来变现，而最大的未知数，也是非常重要的未知数，是我们何时会开始看到AI模型提供商、新的AI搜索提供商（如Perplexity、OpenAI）的影响，他们已明确表示希望成为下一波商业和广告商业的推动者，这将如何影响Meta？

segments.en: We have trouble handicapping that one right now, so some of the disappointment with meta is very strong investment, and a very uncertain future revenue outlook for them in terms of who's going to be coming into their market and impacting themselves.
segments.zh: 我们目前很难评估这一点，所以对Meta的失望在于投入非常强劲，而未来收入前景非常不确定，因为谁将进入他们的市场并影响他们。

segments.en: This week there was a lot of concerns before these earnings of course, Meribault, about circular financing once again, what these hyperscalers, what Nvidia, and how they're becoming big financial players in this whole AI infrastructure build out. How concerned should we really be now about these big, big deals that are coming through?
segments.zh: 本周财报前有很多担忧，Maribel，关于循环融资，这些超大规模云厂商、英伟达如何成为整个AI基础设施建设的金融参与者。我们现在应该对这些大交易有多担忧？
